_notes.purpose: Tunable knobs for the CFD-input stand-in (cfd_input_model.cpp). The 10 Douglas sea states and the paper's calibration anchor points (Hs,T)/(Hs,amplitude) are physical reference data hardcoded in cfd_input_model.cpp, not configured here.
_notes.matrix: buildSeaStateMatrix() builds the 10 (Douglas state) x 3 (direction) x 2 (swell) = 60 cross-product entries at runtime - this file is NOT a per-scenario list.
_notes.duration_period_multiplier: scenario duration = clamp(multiplier * T(Hs), duration_min_s, duration_max_s)
_notes.workspace_margin: see README decision #8 - keeps every generated trajectory within 90% of the paper Table 1 workspace limits
